data.one_liner: Cache function results with optional LRU and expiry support
data.what_it_does: Wraps a function to store its return value so repeated calls with the same arguments return the cached result. Supports LRU caching for parameterized functions and manual expiration.
use_when: Need to speed up expensive pure functions
Want to avoid recomputing results in a widget build
Implement memoization in non-Flutter Dart code
avoid_when: Using inside a build method without persisting the instance
Relying on memoization for side-effectful functions
When thread safety is required (not thread-safe)
strengths: Supports LRU cache and manual expiry
No external build_runner or permissions needed
weaknesses: Requires careful instance management to avoid cache loss
No automatic cache invalidation for changing dependencies
